study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the neuroanatomical heterogeneity of OCD using a framework integrating normative model and non-negative matrix factorization

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used a single-site dataset consisting of 98 first-episode drug-naive OCD patients and 130 healthy controls recruited from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: Ninety-eight first-episode and drug-naive patients with OCD were recruited from outpatient services of the Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University. ... One hundred and thirty healthy controls (HCs) were recruited from the community through poster advertisement.
